objective: DG3 Post-Implementation Audit: skill diff-review (SKILL.md, L1 base rules, L2 fintech pack, L3 data-hub profile, scope.py R0 0-token, report template, OPERATOR_MAP registration) — verify each artifact matches the APPROVED 09_tasks_solution and ADR-07 agnostic core.

claims.claim: SKILL.md documents the 3-layer rule stack L1 base (always loaded, codes B-SEC/B-LOG/B-DES/B-CON), L2 pack by review.packs, and L3 profile as a single file <= 8KB.
SKILL.md limits lens passes R1-R4 to exactly one run and Mode B review to --max-rounds 3, with BLOCKed findings re-checked once then dropped.
fintech.md rule F-LOG-01 at severity S0 forbids floating point types on money and requires integer minor-unit or fixed decimal.
scope.py builds the money-path regex only from keywords supplied by the manifest or packs and sets money_rx to None when no keywords are given.
layer_violations() flags an import as a violation when the imported layer's rank in layer_order is smaller (more outer) than the importing file's layer rank.
review_profile.md records chokepoint CP-1 as MetadataRegistryService.ResolveSourceRoutes with the invariant that 1-to-N shadow routing must select by targetTable/bindingScope and never routes[0].
OPERATOR_MAP.md table 1 contains a diff-review row assigned to QA / Brain for stage S5 or standalone Audit.
scope.py exits with code 3 via die() when the manifest path given by --manifest is not a file.
scope.py hardcodes a default money-path keyword list including 'amount' and 'balance' that is used when the manifest provides none.
SKILL.md allows lens passes R1-R4 to be repeated up to 3 times until no new findings appear.
